canonical_statement: For every finite number n of degrees of freedom, every globally defined C1 flow on canonical phase space R^n x R^n that satisfies Hamilton's equations for a C2 Hamiltonian and the flow laws preserves phase-space Lebesgue volume at every time.
domain_and_universes: Universe 0; n : Nat; PhaseSpace n := WithLp 2 (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n) x EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n)); H : PhaseSpace n -> Real; Phi : Real -> PhaseSpace n -> PhaseSpace n.
quantifiers: Phi : Real -> PhaseSpace n -> PhaseSpace n
hypotheses: for every z, t |-> Phi t z is C1
HasDerivAt (fun s => Phi s z) (hamiltonianVectorField H (Phi t z)) t for every t and z
Phi 0 z = z for every z
Phi (s + t) z = Phi s (Phi t z) for every s, t, z
conclusion: For every t, MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (Phi t) volume volume.
